title: Cyclic tame local chart and uniformizer root along a split trait section
statement: Let $S$ be a normal integral Noetherian quasi-separated scheme, $c:C\to S$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth morphism with geometrically connected fibres, $\sigma:S\to C$ a section, and $G$ a finite group with order invertible in $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $q:C_\eta\to\operatorname{Spec}k(S)$ and $j:C_\eta\to C$ exhibit the generic fibre [def-pc-fibre-product], with a section $s_\eta$ satisfying $q s_\eta=1$ and $j s_\eta=\sigma a_\eta$. Let $Z\to C_\eta$ be a finite etale $G$-torsor with a rational point above $s_\eta$. Let $U\subset S$ contain $\eta$, let $P\to C_U$ be finite etale, and let $j_U:C_\eta\to C_U$ and $\psi:Z\to P$ exhibit its generic restriction, with $i_Uj_U=j$. Let $s\notin U$ be such that every $t\notin U$ specializing to $s$ equals $s$. Put $a:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to S$, $L=C\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}$, $l:L\to C$, and let $N\to C$ be the concrete relative normalization of $P\to C_U\to C$. Let $\tau=(a\sigma,1):\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to L$ be the induced section. Assume $\mathcal O_{S,s}$ is a discrete valuation ring and that $n:N\times_C L\to L$ is finite. For each point $x$ of $N\times_C L$ with $n(x)=\tau(\mathfrak m_{S,s})$, put $B=\mathcal O_{N\times_C L,x}$ and $J=\mathfrak m_{L,n(x)}B$. There exist a commutative local ring $D$, a flat local ring homomorphism $\beta:B\to D$, an element $t\in D$, a positive integer $e$, a field $K$, a group homomorphism $\operatorname{ord}:K^\times\to (\mathbb Z,+)$ and units $\pi,z\in K^\times$ such that $\mathfrak m_D=JD+(t)$, $t^e\in JD$, $z^e=\pi$ and $\operatorname{ord}(\pi)=1$.

source.place: Tags 0EYH and 0EYI(2), proof before the exponent-one inference

proof.text: Apply the tame chart generic-factor theorem without the rational-point hypothesis. It supplies D, beta, t, e, K, ord, pi, b and an open immersion of the polynomial generic factor into the base changed section fibre, together with the local ideal data.

The polynomial X^e-pi has positive degree, so its AdjoinRoot algebra is nonzero. Apply the open-factor rational-point theorem to the given rational point of the G-torsor and the open immersion. It gives a K-algebra homomorphism phi from this AdjoinRoot algebra to K.

Apply AdjoinRoot.aeval_algHom_eq_zero to phi. Simplifying evaluation gives phi(root)^e=pi. Since pi is a unit and e is positive, phi(root) is nonzero. Form the unit z using Units.mk0 and use Units.ext to obtain z^e=pi. Combine this with the local ideal and valuation data from the chart.

theorem GaloisCover.stalk_normalization_trait_section_cyclic_data {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c]
    (σ : S ⟶ C) (hσ : σ ≫ c = 𝟙 S)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    (sη : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Cη) (hsq : sη ≫ q = 𝟙 _)
    (hsj : sη ≫ j = S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S) ≫ σ)
    (Z : GaloisCover G Cη) (hZ : ∃ z : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Z.P, z ≫ Z.π = sη)
    (U : S.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint S ∈ U)
    (jU : Cη ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (ψ : Z.P ⟶ PA.obj.left) (hjU : jU ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι = j)
    (hψ : IsPullback ψ Z.π PA.obj.hom jU)
    (s : S) (hs : s ∉ U)
    (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s)
    (hdvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing (S.presheaf.stalk s)) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    let a := S.fromSpecStalk s
    let n := pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a)
    let τ : Spec (S.presheaf.stalk s) ⟶ pullback c a :=
      pullback.lift (a ≫ σ) (𝟙 _) (by simp [Category.assoc, hσ])
    IsFinite n → ∀ x : (pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
      (pullback.fst c a) : Scheme.{u}),
      n x = τ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (S.presheaf.stalk s)) →
      let B := (pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
        (pullback.fst c a)).presheaf.stalk x
      let J := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pullback c a).presheaf.stalk (n x))).map
        (n.stalkMap x).hom
      ∃ (D : CommRingCat.{u}) (_ : IsLocalRing D) (β : B →+* D),
        IsLocalHom β ∧ β.Flat ∧
        ∃ (t : D) (e : ℕ) (K : Type u) (_ : Field K)
          (ord : Kˣ →* Multiplicative ℤ) (π z : Kˣ),
          0 < e ∧
          IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal D = J.map β ⊔ Ideal.span {t} ∧
          t ^ e ∈ J.map β ∧ z ^ e = π ∧ ord π = Multiplicative.ofAdd 1
